name: Barco NV
summary: Barco NV, together with its subsidiaries, develops visualization solutions, and collaboration and networking technologies for the entertainment, enterprise, and healthcare markets in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the Asia-Pacific. It operates through three divisions: Entertainment, Enterprise, and Healthcare. The company offers medical displays, including radiology, breast imaging, remote reading, digital pathology, surgery, modality, dentistry, and ophthalmoloc solutions. It also provides dental, breast imaging, surgical, clinical review, digital pathology, and all-in-one displays, as well as healthcare software and custom medical solutions; medical display controllers;…
